what_the_test_answers: How much of the observed result could be produced by resampling noise alone?
method: Resample settled observations with replacement, recompute the metric for each resample using at least 500 resamples, and report a percentile interval; NIST describes the bootstrap as an estimator of the uncertainty of a statistic
pre_declared_metric: Percentile interval around the pre-declared metric
what_would_count_as_skill: An interval that excludes the declared luck-only benchmark
what_is_not_evidence_of_skill: A point estimate presented without an interval, or an interval computed after looking at the result

what_the_test_answers: After trying many strategies, how large would the best result look if none of them had skill?
method: Adjust the interval or the decision rule for the number of comparisons; NIST notes that repeating pairwise tests inflates the overall significance level
pre_declared_metric: Number of strategies tried and the adjusted interval
what_would_count_as_skill: One adjusted result that survives the search log
what_is_not_evidence_of_skill: Quoting the best of many unadjusted results
status: Open — search log not kept yet

what_the_test_answers: Does the rule work on data it never saw?
method: Hold out a later untouched block, score only that block and report the block-by-block result
what_would_count_as_skill: A held-out result consistent with the development estimate
what_is_not_evidence_of_skill: Rewriting the rule after seeing the held-out result

what_the_test_answers: Is the model more complex than the data can support?
method: Compare a simple baseline against the complex model; NIST warns that a high R-squared value does not mean the model fits
what_would_count_as_skill: A simpler model that the complex model does not beat
what_is_not_evidence_of_skill: High in-sample fit, or many coefficients on a small sample

what_the_test_answers: Did the result come from beating the price, or from the price moving luckily?
method: Record the price at the decision time and the final price separately, then score the paper return against the recorded decision price
pre_declared_metric: Distribution of the recorded price versus the final price
what_would_count_as_skill: A positive recorded-price edge that persists out of sample
what_is_not_evidence_of_skill: A settled win at a price that had already moved
status: Blocked — no licensed price archive (Flag F07)

what_the_test_answers: How much of the apparent return came from pushes, voids or later stat corrections?
method: Recompute every settled ticket under the provider's written rule and count push and void legs explicitly
pre_declared_metric: Count of push, void and corrected legs
what_would_count_as_skill: A result that holds after pushes and voids are handled as specified
what_is_not_evidence_of_skill: Counting a push as a win

what_the_test_answers: Are repeated observations from the same week or game inflating confidence?
method: Resample clusters by week or by game rather than individual rows, and compare the interval with the naive one
what_would_count_as_skill: The clustered interval still excluding the benchmark
what_is_not_evidence_of_skill: An interval that treats same-game legs as independent

what_the_test_answers: How much should the best of N strategies be discounted?
method: Report the best-of-N value alongside the distribution of best-of-N results under a no-skill benchmark
what_would_count_as_skill: A best entry above the no-skill best-of-N distribution
what_is_not_evidence_of_skill: Congratulating the top row of a round robin

what_the_test_answers: Does the rule survive a rule change, a schedule change or a roster change?
method: Split by the official rulebook season and by season, then report the metric per block
what_would_count_as_skill: Stability across at least two blocks

what_the_test_answers: Are the forecast errors structured in a way the model ignores?
method: Inspect residuals against fitted values and against the availability signal; NIST treats graphical residual analysis as the primary validation tool
what_would_count_as_skill: No visible structure that the model could capture
